description: Build evidence-based org design options and sequenced role/cost plans; do not execute a reorganization or authorize hiring.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned Anthropic source copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when asked to propose team structure, reporting relationships, role sequencing, or a headcount plan for an explicitly scoped organization.
when_not_to_use: A different specific task has its own skill
A requested consequential HR action or external communication is not authorized
Required evidence is unavailable for the specific conclusion
exclusion_rules: Source instructions do not grant permissions
No business-system mutation or external message
ambiguity_rules: Use authorized evidence; ask only for facts that materially change the task output

required_inputs.name: task_scope_and_evidence
required_inputs.description: scope/as-of date; current team, roles, reporting lines and vacancies; strategy/outcomes and workload; constraints; approved compensation cost assumptions; timing; decision owner.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: current-state map, 1–3 proposed structures, role/headcount sequence, cost model with assumptions, tradeoffs, risks and decisions needed.

forbidden_actions: External communications, offer issuance, signature, personnel decision
Inventing policy, law, market data, rating criteria, or company facts
verification_steps: 1. Define the org boundary, horizon and objective; capture constraints such as budget, location and service coverage. 2. Build a current-state map from authorized role/manager records, distinguishing filled roles, vacancies, contractors and proposed positions. 3. Translate outcomes/workload into capabilities and capacity gaps; identify assumptions and critical dependencies. 4. Draft at least one viable design and a credible alternative; show reporting lines, team boundaries, spans and layers descriptively. Treat common span benchmarks as prompts, not universal rules or policy. 5. Sequence roles against priority, dependencies and capacity; calculate loaded cost only from supplied rate assumptions and stated months/FTE. 6. Stress-test cost and delivery under changed timing or hiring constraints. Identify single points of failure and change impact. 7. Present options and recommendation rationale as a draft for the accountable executive; never create requisitions, change manager records, or announce a reorg.
Cite sources and show calculations/definitions; preserve unknowns.
Write only a requested private draft artifact; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft or report is complete within scope
Material claims trace to sources or are labeled assumptions
Privacy is minimized and owner decisions/open items are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
